description: Sixteen gates, one per polyphonic channel, each flipped by its own button or by a channel of a polyphonic gate, with the option of holding every flip back until a trigger arrives

params.text: Steps the module through OFF, MONO and POLY and back round to OFF
Flips one channel's gate open or closed; in MONO or POLY mode the flip is only pencilled in until the S&H input releases it

inputs.text: In MONO mode a voltage at or above 1V on any channel here releases every flip that is waiting; in POLY mode each channel releases only the flip of its own button; in OFF mode the jack is not read
A channel here moving from zero to any other voltage flips that channel's gate, in the same way its button does
The polyphonic signal being gated, each channel passed through while its gate is open and silenced while it is closed

outputs.text: The gated signal; a channel with no matching channel at TO MUTE puts out a flat 10V while its gate is open, which turns the module into a bank of manual gates

notes: all sixteen gates come up closed, so the output is silent until a button is pressed.
the output's channel count is the largest of the three input jacks' channel counts and the number of the highest gate left open.
a channel of FLIP counts as high at any voltage other than zero, negative voltages included, so it is not a 1V threshold like the rest of the plugin.
OFF, MONO and POLY are shown by three lights rather than by the button, and the mode is stepped through in that order.

inputs.0:
high above 1V · stepped · polyphonic

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage does nothing here.
inputs.1:
high above 1V · stepped · polyphonic

unpatched it reads 0V.
inputs.2:
bipolar · continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads 10V.
